policy.before_training: Exact Linux replay and no-completed-input-duplication receipt bound to these runtime hashes
policy.fitness: Existing run/candidate fitness values are frozen and used unchanged for replay. New results use original scoring. CMA-ES code/settings unchanged; no pickle, genome adjustment or approximate matching.

changes: Preserved versions and timestamped hash chain for cloud entry, deadline-aware download/poll/persistence retries and fixed run contract.
Verification phase starts no controller/trainer and writes only its audit receipt on the volume.
Search phase requires the Linux receipt and unchanged source/ledger; one remote Sandbox controller with12h timeout.
Remove runtime35USD cap and prelaunch33threshold; keep guards for unknown submissions, duplicate calls, fixed run parameters, failure limits and per-input deadlines.
Retain all old costs/handles and controller Sandbox reservations; persist progress and CPU records on volume.
Actual laptop-closure verification requires observed provider progress during a real user-confirmed closure.
validation: 113 local tests including actual polling/persistence retries, cap removal without disabling identity/deadline/uncertainty checks, verification-only no-training gate, and worker image inclusion of frozen fitness.
